LanguageData.RHA_FlameTrial030_root.label: First breach
LanguageData.RHA_FlameTrial030_root.description: Threat: Locked attacks leave radius-2 embers for 6 seconds. Answer: Bait the next locked attack into an existing ember, or control its caster; move after the lock. Reward: Consume the ember and cancel that attack; the caster takes 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: Embers deal 25% of base special damage per second; overlapping embers do not stack. Arrangement: Anchor break; forward lock embers. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
